paite: Huchibang a muanhuaitak a thil ahih nung un Assuria kumpipa Sennakerib ahong kuan a, Judah gam ah ahong lut a, kulh nei khuate ahong um a, lak ahong tum hi.
heading: Assuriate'n Jerusalem Akhemlau Uh / (2 Kum 18.13-37; 19.14-19,35-37; Isa 36.1-22; 37.8-38)
english: After these things and this faithfulness, Sennacherib king of Assyria came, entered into Judah, encamped against the fortified cities, and intended to win them for himself.

paite: Sennakerib ahong kuan a, Jerusalem hong sual atum chih Hezekiah in atheih in,
english: When Hezekiah saw that Sennacherib had come, and that he was planning to fight against Jerusalem,

paite: kho polam a tuite hihtat ding in amiliante leh amihatte athuhilh a; huchi in apanpih uhi.
english: he took counsel with his princes and his mighty men to stop the waters of the springs which were outside of the city, and they helped him.

paite: Huchi in mi tampi akikaikhawm ua, tui tengteng leh gamsung a luangsuak luite achingtan ua, Assuria kumpipate ahong lut ua, "Tui tampi bang ding in ahong nei mahmah ding ua," achi uhi.
english: Then many people gathered together and they stopped all the springs and the brook that flowed through the middle of the land, saying, “Why should the kings of Assyria come, and find abundant water?”

paite: Huchi in akihangsak ua, kulh chipna tata abawl a, insungte leh polam kulhte leng abawlhoih hi. David khua ah Millo ahihkip a, galvante leh lumte tampi abawl hi.
english: He took courage, built up all the wall that was broken down, and raised it up to the towers, with the other wall outside, and strengthened Millo in David’s city, and made weapons and shields in abundance.

paite: Kidouna a mipi heutute abawl a, khopi kongkhak mun za lai ah asamkhawm hi.
english: He set captains of war over the people, gathered them together to him in the wide place at the gate of the city, and spoke encouragingly to them, saying,

paite: "Hattak in, hangsantak in om unla, Assuria kumpipa leh aheute mipi lau kei unla, lunglel sam kei un:
english: “Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid or dismayed because of the king of Assyria, nor for all the multitude who is with him; for there is a greater one with us than with him.

paite: Amah lam a pangsa sepaih ahi ua, ei hon panpih ding leh hon dousak ding a ei lam a pang bel TOUPA i Pathian uh ahi ngal a," chi in lungmuanna thu agen hi.
english: An arm of flesh is with him, but Yahweh our God is with us to help us and to fight our battles.” The people rested themselves on the words of Hezekiah king of Judah.

paite: Huai nung in Assuria kumpipa Sennakerib in; amah leh asepaihte Lakish ah a-om ua, Judah kumpipa Hezekiah leh Jerusalem a Judah mi tengteng kiang ah,
english: After this, Sennacherib king of Assyria sent his servants to Jerusalem, (now he was attacking Lachish, and all his forces were with him), to Hezekiah king of Judah, and to all Judah who were at Jerusalem, saying,

paite: "Assuria kumpipa Sennakerib in hichi in achi, Jerusalem lak bang ahia na uplouhna uh?
english: Sennacherib king of Assyria says, “In whom do you trust, that you remain under siege in Jerusalem?

paite: Hezekiah in, TOUPA i Pathian in Assuria kumpipa khut a kipan hon hunkhe ding, chi in gilkial leh dangtak a na sihna ding un ahon khem ahi kei maw?
english: Doesn’t Hezekiah persuade you to give you over to die by famine and by thirst, saying, ‘Yahweh our God will deliver us out of the hand of the king of Assyria’?

paite: Hezekiah mah ahi kei maw, amun sangte leh amaitamte chimsak a Judah mi leh Jerusalem a mite kiang a, maitam khat ah Pathian na be ding ua, gimlim na hal ding uh, chi a thu pepa?
english: Hasn’t the same Hezekiah taken away his high places and his altars, and commanded Judah and Jerusalem, saying, ‘You shall worship before one altar, and you shall burn incense on it’?

paite: Kei leh ka pute'n gamdang mite tung a ka thilhih uh na thei kei ua hia?
english: Don’t you know what I and my fathers have done to all the peoples of the lands? Were the gods of the nations of those lands in any way able to deliver their land out of my hand?

paite: "Kua namte pathian ahia ka pute'n ahihman uh ka khut a kipan a amite uh hunkhe thei om a, noute Pathian in leng ka khut a kipan a ahon hutkhiak theih tuamna ding?
english: Who was there among all the gods of those nations which my fathers utterly destroyed that could deliver his people out of my hand, that your God should be able to deliver you out of my hand?

paite: Huaiziak in Hezekiah in hon khem kei henla, huchibang in hon khem kei henla, amah um kei un; bang nam pathian leh bang gam pathian himhim amite uh ka khut a kipan leh ka pute khut a kipan hunkhe thei a-om kei ua; bangchi in na Pathian un ka khut a kipan a hon hunkhe thei tuam mahmah dia?" chi in Jerusalem ah amite asawl hi.
english: Now therefore don’t let Hezekiah deceive you nor persuade you in this way. Don’t believe him, for no god of any nation or kingdom was able to deliver his people out of my hand, and out of the hand of my fathers. How much less will your God deliver you out of my hand?”

paite: Huan amite'n huai sang a thupi in TOUPA Pathian leh asikha Hezekiah tungtang thu ahoih lou lam in agen uhi.
english: His servants spoke yet more against Yahweh God and against his servant Hezekiah.

paite: Israelte' TOUPA Pathian hehsak ding leh gense ding in lai agelh lai hi. "Gam chih, namte pathiante'n ka khut a kipan amite uh hunkhe thei lou bangmah in Hezekiah Pathian in leng ka khut a kipan amite ahunkhe kei hial ding," chi in.
english: He also wrote letters insulting Yahweh, the God of Israel, and speaking against him, saying, “As the gods of the nations of the lands, which have not delivered their people out of my hand, so shall the God of Hezekiah not deliver his people out of my hand.”

paite: Khua alaktheihna ding un amulkimsakna ding leh lungzinsakna ding in Jerusalem a kulh a omte Judah pau in ngaihtak in akikoukhum uhi.
english: They called out with a loud voice in the Jews’ language to the people of Jerusalem who were on the wall, to frighten them and to trouble them, that they might take the city.

paite: Jerusalem Pathian mihing khut a bawl leitung mite pathian bang lel phet in agen uhi.
english: They spoke of the God of Jerusalem as of the gods of the peoples of the earth, which are the work of men’s hands.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa Hezekiah leh Amoz tapa zawlnei Isai huaiziak in athum ua, van a om asam uhi.
english: Hezekiah the king and Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, prayed because of this, and cried to heaven.

paite: TOUPA'N angel asawl a, huai in Assuria kumpipa giahmun a mihat hangsan tengteng leh makai heutute athat hi. Huchi in zum mahmah melpu in agam lam ah apai nawnta hi. Huan apathian inn a hoh lai ama tapate mahmah in namsau in athat uhi.
english: Yahweh sent an angel, who cut off all the mighty men of valor, the leaders, and captains in the camp of the king of Assyria. So he returned with shame of face to his own land. When he had come into the house of his god, those who came out of his own body killed him there with the sword.

paite: Huchibang in TOUPA'N Hezekiah leh Jerusalem a mite Assuria kumpipa Sennakerib khut a kipan leh midang tengteng khut a kipan ahumbit a, akim ua mite lak ah aveng hi.
english: Thus Yahweh saved Hezekiah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem from the hand of Sennacherib the king of Assyria and from the hand of all others, and guided them on every side.

paite: Huan mi tampi in Jerusalem ah TOUPA a ding in thilpiak ahon tawi ua, thil manpha pipite Judah kumpipa Hezekiah ahong pia ua; huai a kipan in nam chih mitmuh in pahtawi in a-omta hi.
english: Many brought gifts to Yahweh to Jerusalem, and precious things to Hezekiah king of Judah, so that he was exalted in the sight of all nations from then on.

paite: Huai lai in Hezekiah bel sizou ding khop in achina a, TOUPA kiang ah athum a: huan, adawng a, chiamtehna apia hi.
heading: Hezekiah Damlouhna Leh Kisaktheihna / (2 Kum 20.1-3,12-19; Isa 38.1-3; 39.1-8)
english: In those days Hezekiah was terminally ill, and he prayed to Yahweh; and he spoke to him, and gave him a sign.

paite: Himahleh Hezekiah in amah a ding a hoih kihih dungzui in ahih kei a, alungtang hong kisaktheih ziak in ahi; huaiziak in atung ah leh Judahte leh Jerusalem tung ah hehna ahong tung hi.
english: But Hezekiah didn’t reciprocate appropriate to the benefit done for him, because his heart was lifted up. Therefore there was wrath on him, Judah, and Jerusalem.

paite: Himahleh Hezekiah in alungtang kisaktheihna kisik in akiniamkhiak nawn a, amah leh Jerusalem a mite toh; huchi in Hezekiah damsung in TOUPA hehna atung uah ahong tung kei hi.
english: However, Hezekiah humbled himself for the pride of his heart, both he and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, so that Yahweh’s wrath didn’t come on them in the days of Hezekiah.

paite: Huan Hezekiah in sum-le-pai ahau a, athupita mahmah a; dangkasik, dangka-eng, suangmantam, gimlim, lum leh tui-um belsuan hoih pipi koihkhawmna inn alam hi.
heading: Hezekiah Hauhna Leh Thupina / (2 Kum 20.12-19; Isa 39.1-8)
english: Hezekiah had exceedingly great riches and honor. He provided himself with treasuries for silver, for gold, for precious stones, for spices, for shields, and for all kinds of valuable vessels;

paite: Buh, uain leh thau koihkhawmna inn leng alam lai a; gan chiteng koihna leh belam huang leng abawl hi.
english: also storehouses for the increase of grain, new wine, and oil; and stalls for all kinds of animals, and flocks in folds.

paite: Huchi in khuate leng abawl lai a, belamhon leh bawnghon ahau mahmah hi. Pathian in neizoutak in abawl hi.
english: Moreover he provided for himself cities, and possessions of flocks and herds in abundance; for God had given him abundant possessions.

paite: Hezekiah mah in Gihon luitui saknungzaw pen ahubing a, David khua tumlam pang ah aluangkhesak hi. Huchi in Hezekiah athilhih tengteng ah alamzang zel hi.
english: This same Hezekiah also stopped the upper spring of the waters of Gihon, and brought them straight down on the west side of David’s city. Hezekiah prospered in all his works.

paite: Babulon miliante'n palai asawl ua agam a thillamdang adot thu uah alungtang a om tengteng atheihtheihna ding in Pathian in anusia in aze-et hi.
english: However, concerning the ambassadors of the princes of Babylon, who sent to him to inquire of the wonder that was done in the land, God left him to test him, that he might know all that was in his heart.

paite: Hezekiah thilhih dang tengteng, athilhih hoihte, ngai dih, Amoz tapa zawlnei Isai kilakna bu, Judah kumpipa leh Israel kumpite tanchinbu ah gelh in a-om hi.
heading: Hezekiah Vaihawm Sung Leh Asihna / (2 Kum 20.20,21)
english: Now the rest of the acts of Hezekiah and his good deeds, behold, they are written in the vision of Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.

paite: Api-le-pute kiang ah Hezekiah a-ihmu a, David tapate hanmun paitouhna ah avui ua; Judah tengteng leh Jerusalem a mite'n asih ni in thupitak in agal uhi. Asik in atapa Manasseh in vai ahawmta hi.
english: Hezekiah slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the ascent to the tombs of the sons of David. All Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem honored him at his death. Manasseh his son reigned in his place.
